fields.contract:
ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration>.ShardSetReadFirst (where TConfiguration : class, IShardSetsConfigurationOptions, new()) is the fan-out read-first façade over a ShardSet, executing a Query concurrently across either every shard in the shard set or the subset of shards and per-shard parameter values supplied by ShardsValues, optionally injecting each target shard's numeric shardId into a named shardParameterName parameter, and completing as Task<TModel?> with the first non-null TModel produced by any target shard (or default/null when no shard produces a non-null result):

- QueryAsync (8 overloads, where TModel : new()): executes Query with DbParameterCollection and a thread-safe QueryResultModelHandler<object?, TModel> or QueryResultModelHandler<TArg, TModel> (plus TArg dataObject), varying by optional ShardsValues target selection and optional shardParameterName, forwarding to _shardSet.ReadQueryFirstAsync and returning Task<TModel?>.
- MapReaderAsync (36 overloads): executes Query with DbParameterCollection and maps data-reader results into TModel (where TModel : new()), supporting 0 to 8 additional reader-result set types (no TReaderResult, single TReaderResult, or TReaderResult0..TReaderResult7, each constrained new()) via Mapper.ModelFromReaderResultsHandler, varying by optional ShardsValues and optional shardParameterName, and returning Task<TModel?>.
- MapOutputAsync (36 overloads): executes Query with DbParameterCollection and maps output parameters plus 0 to 8 data-reader result sets (no TReaderResult, single TReaderResult, or TReaderResult0..TReaderResult7, each constrained new()) into TModel (where TModel : new()) via Mapper.ModelFromOutResultsHandler, varying by optional ShardsValues and optional shardParameterName, and returning Task<TModel?>.
